installCommand: npm ci && python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
buildCommand: npm run build:analytics && .venv/bin/python scripts/sync_illustrations.py && .venv/bin/python scripts/generate_brand_assets.py && .venv/bin/python scripts/validate_theme_tokens.py && .venv/bin/python scripts/validate_content.py && .venv/bin/python -m pelican content -s publishconf.py && .venv/bin/python scripts/generate_sitemap.py
